attchmntText: Rays of Belief Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Rays of Belief Limited has published its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The publication was released on November 13, 2026, in The Financial Express English and The Jansatta Hindi newspapers. This intimation is submitted pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company requests the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited to take the publication on record.

attchmntText: Rays of Belief Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Rays of Belief Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Audit Committee reviewed the results, which were issued with limited review reports by statutory auditors Suri and Sudhir. The company confirmed no deviation or variation in the utilization of funds raised through its IPO during the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The equity shares of the company were listed on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited on September 8, 2026. The financial results and related information are available on the company website.

attchmntText: Rays of Belief Limited has informed the Exchange about Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
desc: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
